item.description: MINOT, N.D. (KVRR) — The Democrat who lost to Julie Fedorchak for North Dakota’s lone U.S. House seat in 2024 is running against her again. item.title: Plans to reconstruct a section of 13th Avenue South in West Fargo projected to cost $30 million
item.description: WEST FARGO, N.D. (KVRR/KFGO) — West Fargo City Commission is getting a look at a plan to reconstruct a section of highly traveled 13th Avenue South that will cost $30 million. item.title: ND lawmaker who died last month remembered for marching with Martin Luther King, Jr.
item.description: BISMARCK, N.D. (KVRR) — A North Dakota man who marched with Martin Luther King Jr. is also being remembered.
